pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

2. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 13

3. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 31

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

8. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

9. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 13

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 12
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 21 − 9
3. x = 12
Final Answer: x = 12
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. D — 20
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 5
3. Product = 20
Final Answer: 20
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

4. A — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
